steps.content: The torn pieces of paper come together, on it is a handwriting Christina is all too familiar with.
When she saw the first piece, she had guessed, but after really piecing them together...
<size=60>Delicate flowers, fragile and easy to break, are perfect adornments for our banquet.</size>

There's no Blue Rain inside the room, but she can't think straight under the effect of Mania. Christina wants to continue investigating, but she stumbles and falls to the ground, right next to the dried bloodstains, which further intensifies her stress response.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: "Eliminate all impossibilities, and whatever remains, however impossible, must be the truth."

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: A detective... can't refuse the truth.

She gasps for breath, struggling to open her eyes. Looking at the scattered petals before her, she keeps trembling; her vision blurs and sharpens. However, the scattered petals become clearer and clearer before her eyes.
These are petals that were devastated along with all the lives of the Garden Sinners when the incident happened, trampled in this room along with their splattered blood.
Christina looks at the petals, her eyes widening more and more, until finally she grabs them fiercely in her hand.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: But... not all... have been eliminated...
She gets up, unfolding the crumpled petal in her palm.
The petal is full of wrinkles but very clean. It fell on top of a large dried blood stain, yet it doesn't have any trace of it.
She lifts her head to look around at the conspicuous mess, the massive blood stains, and the reckless signs of destruction. It's as if they're highlighting something, but also... hiding something.
